question: The Supreme Court described itself as the "sentinel on the qui vive" in relation to ____________.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Protection of Fundamental Rights**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"sentinel on the qui vive"** was used by the **Supreme Court of India** to describe its role as the guardian of the **Fundamental Rights** enshrined in the **Constitution of India**.
